name: Webflow

agent.name: Lovable
does: Builds full sites and apps from a chat prompt
Syncs code to GitHub and lets you edit it
Publishes to a custom domain on paid plans

whatYouLose: A polished CMS that non-technical editors can use
Fixed costs, since every change uses credits
notes: Lovable is great for getting a site or web app live fast. Marketing teams that live in a visual CMS will miss Webflow's editor.
